title: TransmiterPL - change BG collection period
body:
Now there is fixed (in device) collection period = 5 minutes.
New devices (Transmiter Mini) have possibility to change its in 1 minute steps from 1 to 9 minuts.
Some users ask for it - in case when BG is low/high (out of 80-160) - to increase colection period to 1-2 minutes.
In current devices firmware 'f2' (write) characteristics can accept 1-character command (without confirmation): '1', '2', ... '9' and after receiving - change internal loop() time to 1,2,...9 minutes resp.
In future - this will be extended by other commands as: 'F' - firmware OTA-type upgrade via DFU, 'R' - 'on-demand' BG read from sensor, 'T' - sent 15 trend BG values, 'H' - sent history values from last 8 hours, etc., but it will require more complex and deep changes... :) 

Request is to add in xDrip+ menu->setup  option for change this collection period (when TransmiterPL or LimiTTer device is selected).

comments.body:
This problem is not 100% trivial a few algorithms in the code assume that data is received every 5 minutes.
For example, drop alert or raise alert.
